en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large monument dominated by a standing statue of Dante Alighieri atop a multi-tiered pedestal richly decorated with sculptural groups. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand and walk around the base of the monument. Behind it are trees, a bell tower, and steep rocky mountains. At the top left is handwritten text indicating a date, and printed text at the top right names the monument.
